config.record_grain: One employment-services service-location record per site, contract, and service-area row

fields.evidence: Exact header SITE_ADDRESS_LN; sample row 2 contains '2nd Floor 22 East Row', described by the dataset title/notes as location information. No documentation is supplied to establish a more complete street-address structure.
Exact header SITE_LOCALITY_NAME; sample row 2 value 'CANBERRA' is the location locality.
Exact header SITE_STATE_CD; sample row 2 value 'ACT' is an ontology state value. The enum restricts output to documented ontology values.
Exact header SITE_POSTCODE; sample row 2 value '2601' is a four-digit postcode. The postcode operation preserves numeric text and rejects damaged three-digit values rather than zero-padding them.
Exact header SITE_URL; sample row 2 value 'www.visionaustralia.org.au' is presented as a provider/site URL. The source does not establish ownership by a legal entity.

unmapped_fields.reason: Site/distribution code has no canonical identifier field in the ontology; its scope is undocumented and it is not treated as an entity or address identifier.
Values such as 'DESB' and 'DESA' may be contracts, programs, or reporting groups; the source provides no legal-entity meaning and the ontology has no contract/reporting-group field.
A location label such as 'CANBERRA' is not sufficient evidence of a legal name or trading name and has no separate location-name field.

Retained as the raw subject label via subject_label_field, but values such as 'Vision Australia' and 'Job Centre Australia' are not supported as current legal names or trading names by the undocumented source.

limitations: Documentation is empty; identifier definitions, current-name indicators, update semantics, and field-level authority are unconfirmed.
No source field supports a current legal-name claim, so no entity.legal_name or entity.trading_name observation is emitted. SITE_NAME is retained only as a raw subject label.
The source does not establish legal entities, registered names, entity types, ABNs, ACNs, statuses, or registration dates; no such fields are inferred.
SITE_URL is mapped as a website claim associated with the service-provider/site record, not as proof of legal ownership.
The publication_proxy 2016-05-27T00:00:00 from the source envelope is used under the publication_proxy policy; it is not a row-change timestamp.
Repeated physical locations across contracts or service areas remain separate source observations; no reconciliation is performed.
Malformed three-digit postcodes are quarantined by validation rather than repaired or zero-padded.
All authority and field scores are provisional and require human review.
The source-envelope licence is Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Australia and is emitted by the engine as envelope metadata, not mapped from a source column.
